_read_me: FUB merge field -> what to put in Lofty. Fill each 'lofty' value from the variable picker in Lofty's email template editor (Marketing > Email > Templates > the variables button), then set confirmed to true. A value starting with 'text:' is pasted as plain words (for fields Lofty has no match for). Leave null only for fields in drips you are not building; the converter stops if a drip it builds needs a null field. Pre-filled values come from the Lofty variable list Everitt recorded in January 2026 (FUB_Lofty_Converter repo); still confirm each one in the picker. Checked against the variable list Lofty's Smart Plan email editor loads on 2026-11-20: values marked confirmed are in that list with this exact spelling.

%contact_rels_first_name%.means: lead's first name, plus spouse/partner in FUB ('John & Jane'); Lofty: use the lead's first name

%greeting_time%.means: 'Good morning/afternoon/evening' by send time; Lofty likely has none

%inquiry_address%.means: address of the property the lead asked about

%inquiry_address_preview%.means: photo card of the inquiry property

%viewed_address_preview%.means: photo card of the viewed property

%custom_open_house_address%.means: custom field: open house address (create a lead custom field named Open House Address in Lofty and use the variable the picker shows for it) (Lofty writes custom fields as #custom_field_<field name>#, which only works in an account that has the field, so plain words are used)

%custom_ylopo_seller_report%.means: custom field (Ylopo): seller report link. Only works in a Lofty account with a custom field named custom_ylopo_seller_report; Ylopo users only
